indicators.flag:
A customer conducts transactions with CVC addresses that have been linked to darknet
marketplaces or other illicit activity.
indicators.red_flag: CVC address linked to darknet-marketplace cluster
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D7 (Virtual-currency / blockchain analytics), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.flag: A customer’s CVC address appears on public forums associated with illegal activity.
indicators.red_flag: CVC address surfaced on illicit public forums
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D7 (Virtual-currency / blockchain analytics), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.flag: A customer’s transactions are initiated from IP addresses associated with Tor.
indicators.red_flag: Transactions initiated from Tor IP addresses
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D9 (Identity-verification, document & device/session telemetry), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.flag:
Blockchain analytics indicate that the wallet transferring CVC to the exchange has a suspicious
source or sources of funds, such as a darknet marketplace.
indicators.red_flag: On-chain source of funds traced to darknet
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D7 (Virtual-currency / blockchain analytics), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.flag:
A transaction makes use of mixing and tumbling services, suggesting an intent to obscure the
flow of illicit funds between known wallet addresses and darknet marketplaces.
indicators.red_flag: Use of mixer / tumbler to obscure flow
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D7 (Virtual-currency / blockchain analytics), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.section: Unregistered or Illicitly Operating P2P Exchangers
indicators.flag:
A customer receives multiple cash deposits or wires from disparate jurisdictions, branches
of a financial institution, or persons and shortly thereafter uses such funds to acquire virtual
currency.
indicators.red_flag: Multi-source funnel-in then CVC purchase
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C3 (Multi-originator funnel-in / fan-out network detection).

indicators.section: Unregistered or Illicitly Operating P2P Exchangers
indicators.flag:
A customer receives a series of deposits from disparate sources that, in aggregate, amount
to nearly identical aggregate funds transfers to a known virtual currency exchange platform
within a short period of time.
indicators.red_flag: Aggregated deposits pass-through to CVC exchange
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C2 (Rapid pass-through / flow-through (receive-and-forward) detection).

indicators.section: Unregistered or Illicitly Operating P2P Exchangers
indicators.flag:
Customer’s phone number or email address is connected to a known CVC P2P exchange
platform advertising exchange services.
indicators.red_flag: Identifier nexus to P2P exchange advertiser
indicators.rationale: Gap; C15 (Beneficial-ownership, shell / front-company & nominee network analysis) needs D10 (Customer & account reference / entity-resolution data) enrichment.

indicators.flag:
A customer transfers or receives funds, including through traditional banking systems, to
or from an unregistered foreign CVC exchange or other MSB with no relation to where the
customer lives or conducts business.
indicators.red_flag: No-nexus flows to unregistered foreign CVC MSB
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C20 (Cross-border / high-risk-jurisdiction & corridor anomaly detection).

indicators.flag:
A customer utilizes a CVC exchanger or foreign-located MSB in a high-risk jurisdiction
lacking, or known to have inadequate AML/CFT regulations for CVC entities, including
inadequate KYC or customer due diligence measures.
indicators.red_flag: CVC MSB in high-risk weak-AML jurisdiction
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C20 (Cross-border / high-risk-jurisdiction & corridor anomaly detection).

indicators.flag:
A customer directs large numbers of CVC transactions to CVC entities in jurisdictions with
reputations for being tax havens.
indicators.red_flag: Bulk CVC flows to tax-haven jurisdictions
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C20 (Cross-border / high-risk-jurisdiction & corridor anomaly detection).

indicators.flag:
A customer that has not identified itself to the exchange, or registered with FinCEN, as a
money transmitter appears to be using the liquidity provided by the exchange to execute
large numbers of offsetting transactions, which may indicate that the customer is acting as an
unregistered MSB.
indicators.red_flag: Unregistered customer running offsetting MSB-like volume
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C6 (Transaction-velocity & dormancy / baseline-deviation monitoring).

indicators.section: Unregistered or Illicitly Operating CVC Kiosks
indicators.flag:
A customer operates multiple CVC kiosks in locations that have a relatively high incidence of
criminal activity.
indicators.red_flag: Multiple CVC kiosks sited in high-crime areas
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D7 (Virtual-currency / blockchain analytics), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.section: Unregistered or Illicitly Operating CVC Kiosks
indicators.flag:
Large numbers of transactions from different customers sent to and from the same CVC wallet
address but not operating as a known CVC exchange.
indicators.red_flag: Many customers funnel to one non-exchange wallet
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C3 (Multi-originator funnel-in / fan-out network detection).

indicators.flag:
Structuring of transactions just beneath the CTR threshold or the CVC kiosk daily limit to the
same wallet address either by using multiple machines (i.e., smurfing) or multiple identities
tied to the same phone number.
indicators.red_flag: Sub-threshold structured kiosk smurfing to one wallet
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C4 (Structuring / sub-threshold & reporting-trigger evasion).

indicators.flag:
A customer conducts transactions with CVC addresses that have been linked to extortion,
ransomware, sanctioned CVC addresses, or other illicit activity.
indicators.red_flag: CVC address linked to ransomware / sanctioned cluster
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D7 (Virtual-currency / blockchain analytics), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.flag:
A customer’s transactions are initiated from non-trusted IP addresses, IP addresses from
sanctioned jurisdictions, or IP addresses previously flagged as suspicious.
indicators.red_flag: Transactions from sanctioned / flagged IP addresses
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C20 (Cross-border / high-risk-jurisdiction & corridor anomaly detection).

indicators.flag: Use of virtual private network (VPN) services or Tor to access CVC exchange accounts.
indicators.red_flag: VPN / Tor used to access CVC accounts
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D9 (Identity-verification, document & device/session telemetry), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.flag:
A customer initiates multiple rapid trades between multiple virtual currencies with no related
purpose, which may be indicative of attempts to break the chain of custody on the respective
blockchains or further obfuscate the transaction.
indicators.red_flag: Rapid no-purpose chain-hopping between CVCs
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D7 (Virtual-currency / blockchain analytics), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.flag:
A customer provides identification or account credentials (e.g., non-standard password, IP
address, or flash cookies) shared by another account.
indicators.red_flag: Shared credentials / device across accounts
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D9 (Identity-verification, document & device/session telemetry), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.flag:
A customer conducts transactions or rapidly executes multiple conversions between various
types of different CVCs below relevant due diligence, recordkeeping, or reporting thresholds
and then transfers the value off of the exchange.
indicators.red_flag: Sub-threshold CVC conversions then off-platform transfer
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C4 (Structuring / sub-threshold & reporting-trigger evasion).

indicators.flag:
Discrepancies arise between IP addresses associated with the customer’s profile and the IP
addresses from which transactions are being initiated.
indicators.red_flag: Profile-vs-transaction IP geolocation mismatch
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D9 (Identity-verification, document & device/session telemetry), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.flag:
A customer significantly older than the average age of platform users opens an account and
engages in large numbers of transactions, suggesting their potential role as a CVC money
mule or a victim of elder financial exploitation.
indicators.red_flag: Atypically-old high-volume user (mule / elder-exploitation)
indicators.rationale: Gap; buildable now with C26 (Scam-typology / vulnerable-customer behavioral screening) on D8 (KYC / CDD & beneficial-ownership data).

indicators.flag:
A customer shows limited knowledge of CVC despite engagement in CVC transactions or
activity, which may indicate a victim of a scam.
indicators.red_flag: CVC activity despite no CVC knowledge (scam victim)
indicators.rationale: Gap; buildable now with C26 (Scam-typology / vulnerable-customer behavioral screening) on D8 (KYC / CDD & beneficial-ownership data).

build_logic.window: rolling 30 days per emerging payee relationship
build_logic.source: payment ledger + customer vulnerability segment + payee risk reference

indicators.flag:
A customer declines requests for “know your customer” documents or inquiries regarding
sources of funds.
indicators.red_flag: Refusal of KYC / source-of-funds inquiries
indicators.rationale: Gap; buildable now with C14 (KYC integrity & customer-cooperation screening) on D8 (KYC / CDD & beneficial-ownership data).

build_logic.logic: Flag a customer whose KYC record shows integrity gaps or non-cooperation â overdue EDD documents, refused or evasive responses to information requests, or unresolved inconsistencies â escalating when cooperation failures persist past defined deadlines.
build_logic.source: case-management / KYC remediation system + customer correspondence log
build_logic.route: Tier-1 alert â AML analyst review & EDD gate

indicators.flag:
A customer purchases large amounts of CVC not substantiated by available wealth or
consistent with his or her historical financial profile, which may indicate money laundering, a
money mule, or a victim of a scam.
indicators.red_flag: CVC buys inconsistent with wealth / profile
indicators.rationale: Gap; buildable now with C8 (Income / occupation-vs-activity profile-inconsistency detection) on D8 (KYC / CDD & beneficial-ownership data).

build_logic.logic: Flag a personal account whose inflow volume or wealth velocity is inconsistent with the customer's declared income, occupation, or stated source of funds, escalating when large credits lack a plausible origin for the customer's profile.
build_logic.window: rolling 90 days vs declared income profile
build_logic.source: personal deposit ledger joined to onboarding income/occupation KYC data
build_logic.route: Tier-1 alert â AML analyst review gate

indicators.flag:
A common wallet address is shared between accounts identified as belonging to two different
customers.
indicators.red_flag: Shared wallet across distinct customers
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D7 (Virtual-currency / blockchain analytics), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.flag:
Deposits into an account or CVC address significantly higher than ordinary with an unknown
source of funds, followed by conversion to currency of legal tender, which may indicate theft
of funds.
indicators.red_flag: Outsized unknown-source deposit then cash-out
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C1 (Customer-profile / out-of-pattern transaction monitoring); data D1 (Core transaction monitoring (deposit/account ledger)).

indicators.flag:
Multiple changes to email address and other contact information for an account or customer
which may indicate an account takeover against a customer.
indicators.red_flag: Repeated contact-info changes (account takeover)
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D9 (Identity-verification, document & device/session telemetry), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.flag:
Use of language in CVC message fields indicative of the transactions being conducted in support
of illicit activity or in the purchase of illicit goods, such as drugs or stolen credit card information.
indicators.red_flag: Illicit-goods keywords in CVC message fields
indicators.rationale: Gap; C10 (Transaction-narrative / memo-line keyword screening) needs D5 (Transaction narrative / free-text fields) enrichment.
